text:
michelle_csm: Heads-up — Mariner Logistics renewal ~5w out. Noticed a ~81% drop in prod API volume starting 2026-05-14. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/mariner
alert-bot: ALERT: mariner-prod requests down 81% over 48h. No 5xx spike. Affected routes: /embed, /summarize.
omar_sales: On recent calls they said theyre running a StratusAI pilot this week. Logged it in SFDC under opportunities/ML-pilot.
june_eng: Quick usage query I ran:
```
SELECT day, sum(requests) AS r
FROM usage.prod
WHERE account = 'mariner' AND day >= '2026-05-01'
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 21;
```
Drop starts 2026-05-14 and is account-wide across keys. No deployment or infra alert on that date.
tyler_se: Support ticket shows they toggled client routing to an in-house vector store and changed an embedding batch size. Ticket #5567 has config snips.
michelle_csm: So signals = partial client migration + active competitive pilot. Proposed triage: 1) quick 30m sync with their ML lead (focus on migration reasons), 2) short one-pager comparing cost & latency for their top flows, 3) offer a limited Dedicated credit + A/B pilot where we run the heavier traffic path, 4) a rollback/runback runbook.
omar_sales: Sales prefers a 4-week metered Dedicated credit tied to the joint tech session. I'll draft offer terms. If they insist on Stratus, propose an A/B where we keep control traffic on our endpoints.
june_eng: I can run a 30m "migration backstop" session Wed 11am PT and prep a 1-page runbook showing fallback config, KV prefix caching, and batch-size guidance.
tyler_se: I'll attach the client config screenshots and the support trace to the ticket. Also found one client error where embedding dims were mismatched — could be causing silent drops.
billing-bot: Billing hold requires customer written request + finance approval. Use /billing/hold-request flow with affected API keys.
paula_fin: Acknowledge. Finance will only approve holds with evidence of migration or a billing dispute. If they ask for relief, we need the customer's written ask and the affected keys.
michelle_csm: Action list: Omar — draft credit & commercial language; June — tech deck + runbook; Tyler — attach configs & error trace; Michelle — cost + SLA note and internal renewal risk summary. Set renewal_risk = "elevated" for now.
omar_sales: I'll draft and post the commercial note by EOD.
june_eng: Deck & runbook uploaded to /shared/cs/mariner by EOD tomorrow.
tyler_se: Evidence attached to ticket #5567. Also pinged the ML lead for clarifying the embedding dim issue.
paula_fin: If they request a billing pause, loop finance and include written confirmation from Mariner's procurement. We can expedite but need docs.
michelle_csm: Thanks team. I'll schedule the 30m sync and include procurement + ML lead. Keep updates here; if usage keeps falling before the sync escalate to "high" risk and we'll consider an interim offer. :thumbsup:
